form.oneLiner: Australia's mobile-first bank built for people who actually live on their phones.
form.realStory: We started Up because banking in Australia felt like it was built for a generation that still wrote cheques. So we built Up inside Bendigo's licence — a real bank, designed phone-first from the ground up. Instant notifications. Savers you can name. Pay-day automation that splits your money before you can spend it.
form.customers: Australians 18-34 who want their bank to feel like a product, not a utility — early-career professionals, freelancers, couples managing shared savings goals.
form.proof: 700,000+ customers in 5 years with zero paid acquisition in year one. NPS in the 70s. Maybi shared accounts hit 100k users in 6 months. Backed by Bendigo & Adelaide Bank ADI licence.

brandWorld.brandPersonality: Bold, phone-native Australian bank that makes money feel approachable without dumbing it down
brandWorld.visualDirection: A coral-saturated workspace where black card surfaces punch against the loud background, yellow hits used as the high-contrast signal for numbers, CTAs and headings. Every surface is rounded and tactile — this is a banking app that lives in your pocket, not a boardroom.
avoid: Muted neutrals softening the coral into beige
Generic AI sparkle or fintech dashboard chrome
brandWorld.whyThisWorks: Up's identity is defined by aggressive coral coverage and electric yellow accents on deep black card surfaces — that is their actual product UI and marketing surface, not a style choice we impose. Rounding the cards to ~24px and using yellow exclusively for data callouts mirrors the tactile pill-shaped UI their 500k+ users already trust.
motifs: Rounded transaction cards with category-colour left borders
Spending pulse — horizontal bar fill showing progress toward limit
Yellow highlight bands under key numbers
Pink decorative ink strokes as tertiary illustration accents
brandWorld.backgroundSystem: Flat coral surface with no gradient blobs; black cards sit directly on coral with 24px radius and no drop shadow
brandWorld.deckTheme: Electric coral canvas, black pill cards, yellow data callouts — a mobile bank that looks as alive as the app on your phone
